name: @pudans/api-client
description: Halo-aligned API client generated from pudans OpenAPI documents, wrapped by a shared ApiClient facade.

scripts.generate: rimraf src/api src/models src/api.ts src/base.ts src/common.ts src/configuration.ts && node ./scripts/prepare-spec.mjs && openapi-generator-cli generate -i ./.openapi/aggregated.json -g typescript-axios -c ./.openapi_config.yaml -o src --type-mappings=set=Array --global-property apiDocs=false,modelDocs=false && node ./scripts/post-generate.mjs
